reasons: Directionally correct for us as customer: the inserted Section 4.3 places the transition-assistance, data-return and deletion-certification obligations on HDI (the hosting vendor), tracking the playbook's preferred position (6 months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable return, deletion plus written certification).

Insert is well-placed and minimal: new 4.3 appended after the last subsection of the termination article (p0029) without altering existing text, and it adapts defined terms ('Company', 'Termination Date', 'Content', 'Site') to the agreement's own vocabulary.
Rule-complete: covers all three limbs of the model language and adds express survival, which is necessary because Section 10.7 (p0068) lists only Sections 6.3, 7, 9 and 10.
Missing-status rationale is supported by the cited paragraphs — Section 4 addresses only notice and the Termination Payment, with no exit, data-export or deletion obligation.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice and prefix, explains the change, cites the playbook position and offers the 90-day fallback without lecturing.
